verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 9 285K is a desktop processor. A sandbox test environment separate from production data is an axis for software services, APIs and platforms, not a CPU. Nothing in the evidence shows the product ships such an environment; vPro eligibility and hardware-level security are adjacent hardware features, not a sandbox test environment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
